title: A Comparative Study of Importance Attribution to Columns in Deep Learning over Relational Databases
abstract: arXiv:2611.05986v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Deep learning over relational databases has led to increasingly effective prediction models, motivating a growing need to explain their behavior. We study explanation methods that assign importance scores to individual database attributes, focusing on a fundamental question: to what extent does the choice of importance-attribution method matter? We develop a methodology to systematically compare importance-attribution methods and analyze their similarities and differences. In particular, we study two aspects of the explanations: which attributes they deem important, captured by differences in attribute rankings, and how importance scores vary across attributes, captured by differences in score distributions. We further investigate whether these differences are reflected in the conventional measure of explanation quality, fidelity.   We apply our methodology in an extensive empirical study of four methods: Monte Carlo Shapley, Kernel SHAP

translated_title: 关系数据库深度学习中列重要性归因方法的比较研究
translated_abstract: 基于关系数据库的深度学习催生了日益有效的预测模型，也激发了对解释这些模型行为的需求。我们研究了一类为单个数据库属性分配重要性得分的解释方法，并聚焦于一个根本问题：重要性归因方法的选择在多大程度上会产生影响？我们开发了一套方法论来系统地比较各种重要性归因方法，并分析它们之间的异同。具体而言，我们从两个方面研究这些解释：一是它们认为哪些属性是重要的（通过属性排名的差异来刻画）；二是重要性得分在不同属性之间如何变化（通过得分分布的差异来刻画）。我们进一步探究了这些差异是否能够体现在解释质量的常规度量——保真度中。我们将该方法论应用于对四种方法（蒙特卡洛 Shapley、Kernel SHAP 等）的大规模实证研究。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个系统比较关系数据库深度学习中列重要性归因方法的研究框架，从属性排名和得分分布两个维度分析各方法的异同，并考察这些差异是否反映在传统的保真度指标中。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a systematic methodology to compare importance-attribution methods in deep learning over relational databases, analyzing their similarities and differences in attribute rankings and score distributions, and examining whether these differences are reflected in the conventional fidelity measure.
